name: Strawberry Shortcake's Berry Bitty Adventures
description: Welcome to Berry Bitty City, a berry special little world under the leaves of a berry patch. It may be small, but Berry Bitty City is big on fun and adventure. It's where Strawberry Shortcake and all her friends live. Together, they prove that little girls can do berry big things. There's always something fun to do, and when someone needs help, her friends are always there to lend a hand.

videos.title: A Berry Grand Opening
videos.overview: Strawberry is planning the grand opening of her cafe and asks the berrykins to help out but they don't pay close enough attention and many things go wrong.

videos.title: The Skys the Limit
videos.overview: Treat yourself to some berry fun adventure with Strawberry Shortcake and her friends. While Strawberry works on a scrumptious smoothie recipe for her café, a storm hits and threatens the town’s water supply! Now, the girls must find a way to get water to Berry Bitty City. In the process, they learn that we all make mistakes sometimes, but when we work together, magical things can happen!

videos.title: Berryfest Princess
videos.overview: It’s time for the Spring Festival and Berry Big Parade, and the citizens of Berry Bitty City are excited. They’re also divided, since Strawberry and Orange Blossom are both finalists in the Berryfest Princess selection. And when things don’t go smoothly, Strawberry steps in to lead the way. After learning a lesson about togetherness, the whole town just might enjoy the berry best festival yet!

videos.title: Glimmerberry Ball
videos.overview: It’s winter – the time of year when everyone in Berry Bitty City comes together to celebrate the Glimmerberry Ball! Join Strawberry Shortcake and her friends as they exchange presents, solve the mystery of a hollow tree, and prepare to carve the most spectacular Glimmerberry lantern ever! Through it all, though, the friends remember that the most important thing is to always think of others.

videos.title: Jammin with Cherry Jam
videos.overview: The glow of friendship shines brighter than the spotlight when Strawberry and her pals meet superstar Cherry Jam! Get ready for a rockin' good time as the girls face stage fright, work to impress a talent scout and consider moving to Berry Big City. Along the way, they learn that fame and fortune can be fun, but there's nothing more important than friendship.

videos.title: Fish Out of Water
videos.overview: Orange Blossom adopts a fish but soon discovers its actually a tadpole.  It grows into a frog and causes nothing but trouble.

videos.title: A Stitch in Time
videos.overview: When Raspberry Torte can't make a decision on how to stitch Strawberry Shortcake's new dress Plum Pudding secretly helps.

videos.title: The Vanishing Violets
videos.overview: It's time for the Berry Bitty City Flower Show but Lemon Meringue's prize violets start disappearing.  Is Berrykin Bloom behind it all or is it something else.

videos.title: Babysitter Blues
videos.overview: Baby Berrykin's sparkles are causing all kinds of trouble for Princess Berrykin and everyone at the berryworks.  Strawberry and her friends help out by babysitting and teaching him a lesson in manners.

videos.title: Hair Today, Gone Tomorrow
videos.overview: Lemon Meringue buys a machine to make hair-styling faster and better, but soon feels left out and sad, and worries her job might be over for good.

videos.title: Pop Goes the Garden
videos.overview: Blueberry Muffin planted quick grow daisy seeds but they unexpectedly grow into enormous corn stalks. She and the others must decide what to do with the giant ears of corn before somebody gets hurt..

videos.title: The Berry Best You Can Bee
videos.overview: When a delivery bee is sick, Strawberry offers to help Postmaster Bumble-Bee deliver a special birthday package to Berry Bitty Dale.

videos.title: Strawberry's House Pests
videos.overview: Strawberry lets Jadie Bugs' mischievous spoiled cousins Sadie and Kadie stay with her while their visiting.  Strawberry tries to be the best hostess she can be but things are starting to get out of hand.

videos.title: Berry Bitty World Record
videos.overview: Orange Blossom and the gang try to win a holiday trip for Berrykin Bloom.

videos.title: Too Cool for Rules
videos.overview: Plum Pudding forgets the rules about using Lemon's boat which causes problems for the Berrykins.  Strawberry tries to tell her that Lemon should be able to set the rules for her boat.  Soon everyone is making up strange rules.

videos.title: Berry Best Berryfest Princess
videos.overview: It's springtime in Berry Bitty City which means it's time for the Berryfest!   Princess Berrykin is away so Berry Bitty City must hold it's first election for Berryfest Princess!

videos.title: Strawberry's Berry Big Parade
videos.overview: As Berryfest Princess Strawberry is in charge of the parade and she needs help.  Will her friends settle their differences in time to make it a success?

videos.title: The Berry Best Choice
videos.overview: Strawberry learns how to be a leader and face obstacles to make sure the BerryFest is a success.

videos.title: Nothing to Fear But Berries Themselves
videos.overview: Orange Blossom fears that the Gumper Lump is real and when there's a power cut in Lemon's salon, the girls act silly and thinks it does exist .

videos.title: Where, Oh Where has Our Blueberry Gone?
videos.overview: Blueberry starts reading Patty Persimmon mystery novels and forgets about meetings or appointments with her friends.

videos.title: Manners Meltdown
videos.overview: Blueberry forgets her manners and when the Berry Derby party where she tells everyone to act politely.

videos.title: Trading Sizes
videos.overview: Raspberry finds a way to enlarge Berrykins to the same size as Strawberry and her friends.

videos.title: Different Waltz for Different Faults
videos.overview: Plum tries to get her friends and the Berrykins to dance like a rival dance team, to win the Dance-Off trophy.

videos.title: Happy First Frost
videos.overview: Blueberry gives a First Frost Day gift that's more what she wants than the recipient.

videos.title: A Circle of Friends
videos.overview: Raspberry gets upset when she suspects her friends of copying her lantern design for the Glimmerberry Gathering.

videos.title: The Glimmerberry Ball
videos.overview: Plum finds an ideal location for the Glimmerberry Ball, but two chipmunks keep crashing her party.

videos.title: Nice as Nails
videos.overview: Lemon's manicure creations initially delight her friends but eventually grows tiresome.

videos.title: How You Play the Game
videos.overview: Orange works out a plan to ensure that the whole community has equal access to Berry Bitty City's public spaces.

videos.title: Good Citizens Club
videos.overview: Sadiebug and Kadiebug create a new club.

videos.title: Team for Two
videos.overview: Princess Berrykin gets help from her friends to build a day-care center for the Baby Berrykins, but they disagree about how things should be done.

videos.title: Lost and Found
videos.overview: Pupcake and Custard, unable to convince Strawberry to play with them, chase after a butterfly into a forest while a storm looms overhead. Meanwhile, Strawberry's at Mr. Longface's party wondering where Pupcake and Custard have disappeared to.

videos.title: The Berry Big Harvest
videos.overview: Orange Blossom struggles to deal with an overflow of new products at her store.

videos.title: Room at the Top
videos.overview: Building begins on Strawberry's new marketplace, and her pals give her lots of suggestions.

videos.title: Starlight, Star Bright
videos.overview: Strawberry's favorite singer, Cherry Jam, performs at the Marketplace, and Strawberry and her pals get to know what the real Cherry is like off stage.

videos.title: Practice Makes Perfect
videos.overview: Cherry Jam wants to showcase her students in a recital, but Plum gets nervous about performing.

videos.title: Top Talent
videos.overview: The girls prepare for a talent show, and Lemon rejects any assistance with her performance.

videos.title: A Star is Fashioned
videos.overview: Raspberry considers moving to the big city in order to work with top fashion designers.

videos.title: No Blueberry is an Island
videos.overview: Blueberry thinks Strawberry is planning a tropical getaway for her pals, so she shares this news with them and asks them to keep it a secret.

videos.title: Where the Berry Breeze Blows
videos.overview: Bad weather ruins the girls' vacation plans, so Orange tries to recreate a resort area at home.

videos.title: The Berry Best Vacation
videos.overview: The girls' vacation gets interrupted when a TV reporter stops by to interview Cherry.

videos.title: On the Road
videos.overview: The girls train the Berrykins to run their businesses while they head out of town on a concert tour.

videos.title: The Berry Long Winter
videos.overview: Warm weather arrives early in Berry Bitty City, but then the temperatures drop and the townsfolk consider sharing their winter food supplies.

videos.title: The Big Freeze
videos.overview: Blueberry creates new skates powered by parasols, and then makes a musical commercial showcasing them.

videos.title: On Ice
videos.overview: Strawberry's pals plan events at the same location, so Strawberry suggests they merge their events.

videos.title: A Boy and His Dogs
videos.overview: In the third-season opener, Strawberry and her pals befriend Huckleberry Pie after they assist him with some stray dogs.

videos.title: Partners in Crime
videos.overview: Blueberry and Huckleberry become writing partners, but she rejects all of his story ideas, so he teams up with Cherry Jam to write a song.

videos.title: The Mystery of the Disappearing Dog Show
videos.overview: Strawberry hosts a dog show to raise money for Huckleberry's pet shelter, and Plum tries to make the performances extra special.

videos.title: Snowberry and The Seven Berrykins
videos.overview: Plum directs a play based on a fairy tale to entertain the Baby Berrykins, but her over-the-top production descends into chaos.

videos.title: Berryella and Prince Charming
videos.overview: The girls convince Huck to portray a prince in their play, despite his stage fright and lack of performance skills.

videos.title: The Littlest Berrykin
videos.overview: The girls envision themselves as princesses searching for a fabled berry in the play Blueberry and Huckleberry are narrating.

videos.title: The Berry Big Relay Race
videos.overview: The juice system that provides electricity to the town breaks down, so a group of Berrykins work on repairing it while the girls keep busy by holding a relay race.

videos.title: The Berry Best Treasure
videos.overview: The girls embark on a treasure hunt and wind up looking for missing puppies.

videos.title: The Berry Scary Fun Adventure
videos.overview: The girls go camping and suspect a creature is in the woods, so they try to trap it.

videos.title: The Berry Lucky Day
videos.overview: Huck finds a good-luck charm and achieves success before he finds out the charm is Cherry's. Strawberry then helps both Huck and Cherry uncover the true origins of their luck.

videos.title: All Dogs Allowed
videos.overview: A new dog park is built in town, but something mysterious is scaring the puppies away from it, so the girls must figure out what it is before they hold a tea-party celebration in honor of the new park.

videos.title: A Basket of Blue Berries
videos.overview: After Blueberry invites Huck to the Masquerade Ball, she becomes ill and stays home sick. Raspberry and Lemon try to help by secretly pretending to be Blueberry, but things only get confusing, especially when the real Blueberry arrives.

videos.title: The Berry Biggest, Berry Baddest Bakeoff
videos.overview: The girls decide to each bake Berrykin Bloom the perfect cupcake but things spiral out of control when they compete with each other to create the biggest and best cupcake ever!

videos.title: Berry Double Trouble
videos.overview: Raspberry and Lemon want to join a fashion contest. They offer Strawberry to be their model, but she is too busy running both her café and the market. Raspberry and Lemon meet the twins Sweet and Sour Grapes, whose names fit their personalities and offer them to replace Strawberry in the café.

videos.title: Berry Bitty Adventurer
videos.overview: Apple Dumplin' comes to visit her cousin Strawberry. Soon she causes trouble: she installs a light/music display in Strawberry's bedroom, but cannot turn it off; later she causes a power failure. After Apple leaves, it is revealed that she fixed the power.

videos.title: High Tech Drama
videos.overview: Lemon and Raspberry make the final preparations for the contest. Strawberry offers the twins to be models at the contest instead of her. Sweet is delighted, but Sour is not excited. Shortly before the show is broadcast, Sour sabotages the TV equipment.

videos.title: A Berry Merry Birthday
videos.overview: The twins' birthday is approaching. Sour says she does not wish to share the birthday with Sweet. Sweet is sad that her sister feels that way but respects her wish. Sour initially enjoys having a birthday of her own and the activities the Berry girls plan for her, but gradually feels lonely without her sister, and regrets what she said earlier.

videos.title: Tall Tale Trio
videos.overview: The Berry girls go on their annual camp-out. Cherry, Plum and Orange become tired on the way to the camping site and stop to rest. When they catch up with the other girls, each of them has a different version of the adventure they had.

videos.title: Berry Big Tale-Teller
videos.overview: Sour implores Sweet to help her recount the Adventures they had in the Berry Deep Dark Forest, but her performance is so embellished that Sweet can't keep up.

videos.title: The Berry Bitty Great Race
videos.overview: At the camping site, Apple tells a story about the great race she participated and won, although the other competitors cheated and did their best to stop her by using dirty tricks.

videos.title: The Berry Best Taste Test
videos.overview: Apple's rave review of Strawberry's dessert encourages the Queen of Berryvania to order her new cake for her ball.

videos.title: The Berry Best Biscuit
videos.overview: Sour and Apple begin a prank war and they are sentenced in a Berry Bitty City-style trial to camp alone together for a whole weekend.

videos.title: Hot Sauce Cook Off
videos.overview: Berrykin Bloom's braggart cousin, Berrykin Bertram, has won the hot sauce competition at the local county fair year after year, but this year, Sour and Apple are determined to help the kindhearted Bloom win.

videos.title: The Berry Bitty Dance Disaster
videos.overview: Apple joins Plum's ballet class. When she realizes she is not as good as the others, she decides to make a pair of dancing shoes which she calls "Groove Booties". But they escape and wreak havoc in the town. Apple must find a way to stop the Booties before they ruin the Berryball game.

videos.title: Doggie Dance No-Show
videos.overview: Apple makes improved Groove Booties that can teach anyone to dance, including the puppies Pupcake and Pitterpatch. This gives Plum the idea to put on a show of dancing dogs. She asks Huckleberry if Tom Tom would like to participate, and he agrees.

videos.title: Dance Puppy Dance
videos.overview: Apple and Plum ask Cherry to compose music for the video of the dancing dog show so that it can be uploaded to Apple's website. Cherry is very busy writing a song for the queen of Berryvania but takes a break to do as they ask her.
